description: Geodetic Survey Mark Reference Marks (Point) (LGATE-199) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This dataset complements LGATE-076. It contains horizontal and vertical coordinates of Reference Marks (RM) for Standard Survey Marks (SSM) and Bench Marks (BM). The attributes include the RM observations between the Reference Mark and the Parent Geodetic Mark. © Western Australian Land Information Authority (Landgate). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are assessment, bench, bm, flat, geodetic. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, pdf. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
